in_english.long_meaning: Hendrika is a Germanic name composed of Hendrik and -rika, derived from Henry the Great and the feminine suffix -rika. It is related to the Old High German name Heimeric and the Old Norse name Henrik. In the Middle Ages, Hendrika was used as a given name in the Netherlands and Germany, and it was also used as a surname. In Christianity, Hendrika is associated with Saint Henry, a 10th-century German king and saint, and it is also related to the biblical figure of King David, who was a great king and a righteous man. Hendrika is a classic name that symbolizes strength, courage, and leadership, and it is often given to girls born into families with Germanic or Christian heritage.
